Corrected Reflectance.name: VIIRS NOAA-20 True Color
Corrected Reflectance.description: True-color imagery from VIIRS on NOAA-20 satellite. 375m resolution, complements SNPP coverage.

Temperature.name: Surface Air Temperature (Day)
Temperature.description: Daytime air temperature at 2 meters above surface. Useful for heat wave monitoring and climate analysis. From AIRS instrument.

Temperature.name: Surface Air Temperature (Night)
Temperature.description: Nighttime air temperature at 2 meters above surface. Shows temperature patterns and urban heat effects.

Temperature.name: Land Surface Temperature (Terra, Day)
Temperature.description: Daytime land surface temperature showing how hot the ground surface is. 1km resolution, useful for drought and urban heat monitoring.

Temperature.name: Land Surface Temperature (Aqua, Day)
Temperature.description: Afternoon land surface temperature from Aqua satellite. Complements Terra for diurnal temperature analysis. 1km resolution.

Precipitation & Soil Moisture.name: Precipitation Rate (30-min)
Precipitation & Soil Moisture.description: Global precipitation measurement from GPM satellite constellation. Shows rainfall intensity in near real-time. 10km resolution, 30-minute updates.

Water Vapor & Clouds.name: Water Vapor (MODIS Aqua, Day)
Water Vapor & Clouds.description: Total column water vapor from MODIS. Shows atmospheric moisture content. 5km resolution, useful for weather forecasting.

Water Vapor & Clouds.name: Cloud Top Temperature (Aqua, Day)
Water Vapor & Clouds.description: Temperature at cloud tops. Lower temperatures (colder) indicate taller clouds and potentially severe weather. 5km resolution.

Water Vapor & Clouds.name: Cloud Top Temperature (Terra, Day)
Water Vapor & Clouds.description: Cloud top temperature from Terra satellite. Helps identify storm systems and convective activity. 5km resolution.

Ocean & Water Quality.name: Sea Surface Temperature
Ocean & Water Quality.description: Multi-sensor blended sea surface temperature. Shows ocean temperature patterns, upwelling zones, and thermal fronts. 1km resolution, daily.

Aerosols & Air Quality.name: Aerosol Optical Depth
Aerosols & Air Quality.description: Combined aerosol optical depth from Terra and Aqua MODIS. Shows air quality, dust storms, smoke from fires. Higher values indicate more aerosols. 10km resolution.

Aerosols & Air Quality.name: UV Aerosol Index
Aerosols & Air Quality.description: Detects absorbing aerosols like dust and smoke using UV measurements. Positive values show dust/smoke events. 13km resolution, daily coverage.
